note: Named from blind profiles before viewing players. Keys are frozen family ids (F1 = C1 of reports/archetypes/k3/). League = mean over the 750 fitted player-seasons.

F1.name: On-ball Shot Creators
F1.reason: Create their own offense: fewer made shots assisted (54.5% vs 67.1% league), more assists (7.1 vs 5.2 per 100), higher usage (26.3 vs 22.0 shot attempts + TOV per 100), more pull-up/step-back 3s (15.3% vs 9.3% of FGA) and more drives (26.1% vs 20.6% of FGA).

F2.name: Off-ball Spot Ups
F2.reason: Finish plays others create: more made shots assisted (77.1% vs 67.1%), more corner 3s (19.9% vs 12.4% of FGA), lower usage (18.5 vs 22.0), fewer assists (3.9 vs 5.2), fewer fouls drawn (2.3 vs 3.4 per 100) and fewer drives (18.2% vs 20.6%).

F3.name: Bigs
F3.reason: Play near the basket on both ends: OREB% 9.4% vs 4.6%, DREB% 19.3% vs 13.1%, blocks 2.1 vs 1.0 per 100, about half of FGA at the rim (51.5% vs 30.6%), few above-break 3s (13.2% vs 29.6%) and almost no pull-up 3s (1.1% vs 9.3%).
